description.value: Rosedale on Robson Suite Hotel is an all-suite property in downtown Vancouver where every room includes a fully-equipped galley kitchen and a separate living area, making it well-suited for multi-night stays. The hotel features an indoor pool complex with a lap pool, hot tub, and dual saunas, alongside an on-site breakfast room. It sits close to Pacific Central Station and Vancouver's sports and entertainment district.
